name: Ghost
tagline: A 3D-printed Destiny Ghost that listens, talks back and opens like the in-game scan.
facts: 12 STL files, about 500 g of filament, about 32 hours of printing
180 mm tip to tip closed, 200 mm open
Shell built straight from the Bungie reference sheet: the same 8 pieces
Each shell piece rides a spring-loaded pin; a Bowden cable to a servo pulls them shut
Raspberry Pi 4, a round 1.28 inch LCD eye, I2S mic and amp, 16-LED ring, three servos
Wake word and speech-to-text run offline on the Pi
Personality is Claude with emotion tags that drive the eye, the lights and the body
Parametric generator: every dimension is a parameter, collisions checked automatically
Fan project. Destiny and the Ghost belong to Bungie.
